projects.title: Spotify 2023 Wrapped
projects.meta: Infused with vibrant energy, 2023 Wrapped takes a playful twist on data viz. Made in collab with Spotify’s in-house creative team.

info.title: Raw, Playful, and Honest. Reflect on your feelings in 2023. The most anticipated event of the year by creators and fans alike.
info.copy: For the 7th year in a row, we teamed up with Spotify’s in-house creative team to celebrate the creators that power the platform. Artists, songwriters, and podcasters are invited to explore a series of bespoke, immersive data stories breaking down their biggest milestones. Infused with vibrant energy, 2023 Wrapped brings a playful twist to data visualization.

projects.title: Patreon.com
projects.meta: Patreon helps people around the globe turn their online passion into a full-time career

info.title: Step into a world of digital delight with Patreon’s new, creator-centric website redesign
info.copy:
The digital world is changing fast, and more and more folks around the globe are turning their online passion into a full-time career. Buttermax teamed up with Patreon to give their website a new look, but also to show off all the smart new app features built specifically for creators, making them feel right at home.

Patreon is all about celebrating its creators and making sure they feel appreciated and heard when they’re exploring the site. We've accomplished this by using vibrant, full-bleed imagery, interactions inspired by creators, and non-conforming typographic layouts.

projects.title: GDK.com

info.title: Super fresh visuals and even fresher ingredients for the kebab of the future.
info.copy:
Humankind has been cooking meat on a rotating stick for hundreds of thousands of years. But if anyone can bring this age-old practice into the future, it’s German Doner Kebab. They just needed our help making a website for it.

Built with WebGL and plenty of animated UI, visitors to the new GDK.com scroll through the streets of a stylized London and land at a counter ready to serve up some delicious kebab. We’ve even included some to-go boxes for diners on the go.

GDK might not have a location in your city yet, but this site will take you so close you can almost taste it.

projects.meta: German Doner Kebab: Spinning tradition into the future with a tasteful twist. Explore GDK.com’s WebGL wonderland, serving up delectable kebabs with animated flair. Get a taste of what’s to come, even if there’s no GDK near you!

projects.title: Spotify Rap UK

info.title: Level up with Spotify’s Day 1 Club RapUK. Elevate your status and see where you stand. Are you an OG?
info.copy: Spotify’s Day 1 Club interactive experience allows listeners to prove which artists they’ve been supporting since day one, introducing a unique fan-first experience that connects artists and fans, drives buzz on social media, engages the community and amplifies Spotify as the ultimate destination for fans of Hip-Hop and Rap.

projects.meta: Spotify’s Day 1 Club: Uniting fans and artists, driving social buzz, and amplifying Hip-Hop’s heart. Discover the fan-first journey.

projects.title: Dreamwave 2.0

info.title: Dreamwave is the future of social experiences on the web. This site is the next best thing.
info.copy:
Dreamwave is Active Theory’s in-house technology solution for building immersive 3D experiences, from concerts to conferences. But who do the website people come to when they need a website for their website platform? Buttermax, of course.

Working with Dreamwave strategy and product leads, we built a site to outline the product features through a clean UI and fun microinteractions and animations powered by WebGL. There’s a custom CMS under the hood too, so the Dreamwave team can keep everything up to date as they continue to innovate in the world of microverses, metaverses, or whatever the next -verse is.

projects.meta: Buttermax crafted Dreamwave’s web presence for immersive 3D experiences. Explore Dreamwave's real-time webxr product through the carefully crafted dreamwave.tech website.

projects.title: Chrome Pit Crew

info.title: The  McLaren  F1  Pit Crew  can  complete  a  pit  stop  in  an average  of  2.74  seconds.  Can  you  beat them?
info.copy:
Google Chrome and McLaren F1’s partnership is built for speed - Chrome’s technology is a big contributor to what makes the McLaren F1 team so fast and keeps them safe.

To celebrate the 2022 US Grand Prix, we teamed up to create Chrome Pit Crew, a series of minigames that highlight the browser’s features while testing your timing, speed, and balance.

projects.meta: Chrome & McLaren F1's speed synergy: Pit Crew minigames. Test Chrome’s power while fine-tuning your timing, speed, and balance.

projects.title: Reliable Robotics

info.title: Reliable Robotics is giving flight to automated aviation. We made their website soar.
info.copy:
Reliable Robotics is building advanced automation systems that make aviation safer. But how do you represent such complex, important work in a way that is easily digestible and fun to interact with?

We swooped in to help RR build a new website, using 3D animations to tell the story of their product through a sequence of stylized vignettes. By scrolling along, users move from one 3D scene to the next to learn about this groundbreaking company.

Check out the site for yourself, and get ready to take flight.

projects.meta: Reliable Robotics soars in aviation safety. Explore their world via 3D storytelling. Get ready to take flight with this groundbreaking company.

projects.title: The Dreamkeeper

info.title: The Dreamkeeper uses AI to transform people’s dreams into shareable, animated visualizations.
info.copy:
Have you ever woken up from a dream and wished you could make it reality? With The Dreamkeeper, you can do exactly that thanks to the power of AI.

The AI tool leverages multiple models including a ChatGPT powered "Dream Assistant" to help you recall your dreams, Stable Diffusion to visualize them, and a gallery that uses classical ML and LLM embeddings to allow you to experience other people's dreams. Hopefully all those acronyms didn’t put you to sleep.

The project was a collaboration with Atlassian, Droga5, and Addition Technologies - truly the dream team!

projects.meta: The Dreamkeeper turns dreams into reality using AI and Stable Diffusion. Explore dreams, create your own, and join our dream team.

projects.title: Google Search Through Time

info.title: Take a trip down Google Search’s memory lane (it’s not your average baby book)
info.copy:
Nowadays, you don’t even have to say the phrase "search the internet" – just say "Google it." It’s hard to imagine, but there was a time before!

Alongside the Google team, we built this interactive timeline to visualize how Google Search has transformed the way we explore the web.

With a mixture of interactive 3D objects and hand drawn illustrations, you can move seamlessly through the lifetime of Search since its birth in 1997. You’ll spot vital tools like Google Maps, and even some fun stuff like the first Google Doodle.

Bet you didn’t know all the ways that Google Search has touched your life!

projects.meta: Explore the evolution of web search with Google’s interactive timeline. Discover how Google Search transformed your online journey.
